title: Withhold a memory key whose retirement target is a held removal absent from the folder, on the holder's export
outcome: Withhold a memory key whose retirement target is a held removal absent from the folder, on the holder's export
acceptance: An incremental export from a host that holds another host's removal of task T (T in the folder head's pending set, its file absent from the folder) does not publish a memory key whose revision retires with T, or refuses it by name, so no receiver meets memory_retiring_target_missing while the hold lasts; a behavioural CLI test covers it
